question: Who becomes the Bucs' WR1 if Mike Evans is out?
answer:
Deebo Samuel is next at WR on the depth chart (11.1% recent target share), so for fantasy: pick up Deebo Samuel. Mike Evans's 27.1% target share leads the 49ers' skill position group, but since he is out, the fantasy allocation drops to the next available WR. By recent target share, the WRs below Evans are ordered Brandin Cooks at 7.2%, Jacob Cowing at 3.7%, and further down; Deebo Samuel's 11.1% target share is the highest among this group, making him the top fantasy WR option if Mike Evans is inactive.
